title: Horizon Europe Cluster 5 Info Day: Climate, Energy and Mobility
summary: A hybrid day presenting the 2027 funding topics of Cluster 5, with policy context and advice on preparing a strong proposal.
details: The programme covers the policy context, a session with tips for strong proposals, and parallel thematic sessions presenting each 2027 topic, with questions and answers. It runs from 09:00 to 16:00 CET.
why: This is the most direct way to hear how the Commission reads the 2027 Cluster 5 topics. Consortia already forming should bring specific questions on scope and expected impact.
